description: v5 — pool-based curated GIFs with anti-stale rotation, position-percentile triggers, and composite overlays for headline-tier wins. Based on docs/auction/analysis_v5_canon_aware.md. Worker evaluates scenarios in order; first scenario whose trigger matches AND survives probability_pct picks a GIF from its pool_id (rotated to avoid last 3 used).

schema_v2_notes.pools: Named GIF buckets. Scenarios reference pools by id. A pool can be shared by multiple scenarios. Each entry: { url, label?, weight? }. Worker rotates: picks from (pool.gifs - last_3_used). Empty pools = scenario falls through to Giphy fallback.
schema_v2_notes.scenarios: Ordered priority list. Worker evaluates top-down; first scenario whose trigger matches AND survives probability_pct wins. Fields:

trigger_fields.min_position_percentile: 0-100; win_k must be ≥ the player's position p[N] from POS_P90 constants in worker
trigger_fields.duration_hours_min / duration_hours_max: Open-lot duration thresholds (for live mid-auction triggers)

schema_v2_notes.overlay_pool_id: Optional. If present, fires a SECOND GIF from this pool composed alongside the main pool's GIF. Used for headline+all-time tier where one player-celebration + one shock GIF land together.
schema_v2_notes.rotation: Worker tracks last 3 GIFs picked from each pool in module-scope Map. Same GIF can't fire 3 times in a row. Resets on worker cold-start (~hourly in practice — fine for an auction).
